# LEO vs synthetic US-style gold (patient level)

**Coverage.** L1C manifests cover 277/443 notes (5/90 patients have every note). Aggregation uses only covered notes. Do not quote these F1s as a complete-patient result. Full-coverage EpExtra table: `leo_vs_synth_gold_slices_polish90_eonly.*`. Short table: `leo_vs_synth_gold_slices_polish90.tables.md`.

*Generated by `scripts/score_leo_vs_synth_gold.py`.  Unit = patient (notes aggregated); 90 patients (polish_train 90); seven fields.  `llm` = Med42-8B alone, `specialist` = EpExtra alone, `leo_auto` = claims routed ACCEPT, `leo_review` = ACCEPT + REVIEW.*

Current-ASM view: maintenance only (rescue drugs do not count); acute administrations never count.
